تعتمري (form VIII)
# تَعْتَمِرِي (taʕtamirī) /taʕ.ta.mi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
# تُعْتَمَرِي (tuʕtamarī) /tuʕ.ta.ma.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَمَرَ (iʕtamara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
